A common question I get asked is what do I focus on and how do I create my lessons? The most basic answer I can give is that, when topics are presented and thought of in a way that gets people to think of how it applies to their life, or in what way can it inspire them in some way to make a difference, or how it can be applied to people as a whole, is when I feel like learning a language is more than just about learning it as a concept, but when it's about digging into ourselves on a deeper level, and being able to express ourselves in more than one language makes it all the more worthwhile. So, my motto is.... enjoy the ride, and don't worry, be happy. Also, I am on Italki as an Informal Tutor and would like students who are serious or only interested in improving their language skills to sign up and take a session with me.

I also provide my students with extra practice outside of the lessons such as watching videos, doing listening exercises and listening to music because I believe that being exposed to native input is the next best thing after communicating with native speakers. Are you ready to learn Spanish through Comprehensible Input? I mean really acquire, understand and produce the Spanish language at your own pace? Well these are the lessons for you! Whether you are have a little experience, some experience or absolutely no experience with the Spanish language, this approach will help you acquire Spanish in a fun and meaningful way. 

What is Comprehensible Input (C.I.) anyway? Comprehensible Input simply refers to words and phrases that you can understand in another language through reading and/or listening at any given moment. I teach using solely this method so that you don't have to worry about boring textbooks, memorizing grammar rules or vocabulary lists or any of the painfully ineffective teaching methods you experienced in high school or college. 

Each class will be specially designed to suit your needs. During these classes we will focus on all four language skills (reading, writing, listening, speaking). I will provide all of the materials for you each class. There will be articles, photo/video description activities, songs and song lyric activities, writing activities, games and much more! 

These lessons are recommended for students who really want to be immersed into the Spanish language and the culture surrounding it. 

So, are you ready to start your Spanish journey and enjoy every moment of it? Book a class and experience a Spanish class that you've always wanted, but never knew existed!

¡Nos vemos pronto! 
(See you soon!)

****I do not provide lessons for young children. The appropriateness of lessons for adolescents will be assessed on a case by case basis. In my experience, lessons for adolescents work best when supplemented with language lessons in school.****

pro_course_detail.description:
Are you desirous of improving your accent in order to become more understandable to others? Would you like to sound more like a native English speaker from the United States?

This course is for you!

I will take you step by step through the basic sounds, vowels, and consonants that make up the American accent. Not only will your accent improve with time, but you will learn a lot about why the American accent sounds the way that it does. 

You will also learn about regional variances in the American accent like California, New York, the Midwest etc.

The only requirements for taking this course are the following:

1. You are mentally prepared to receive corrections. Sometimes receiving corrections can feel uncomfortable at first. However, if you remember that these corrections are to help you improve, you will achieve your goals.

By actively participating in these lessons, you will be making important steps towards improving your American English pronunciation skills. I will give you useful corrections during and after our lessons so that you can improve gradually. 

Give accent coaching a try. Your future self will thank you!

pro_course_detail.title: Story Time!
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, we will read short stories and/or books together. Stories are a great way to keep us interested and engaged in learning. We will alternate reading in order to work on your pronunciation while you are reading and your listening while I am reading. We will slow down and focus on tricky grammatical structures as well. The key is to make sure that we get the MEANING. I will also have noted some key vocabulary which towards the end of the lesson you will try to use by forming sentences. Generally the books will be in the young adult/teen category of books. (i.e. Bridge to Tarabithia/The Lion, The Witch and The Wardrobe/The Little Prince) but I am certainly open to suggestions as well. Come on! Let's read!

Note: I do recommend a package for these lessons so that we can complete the story or novel and devote more time to understanding its meaning and themes.

pro_course_detail.title: Informal Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description: Let's chat! This is an option for those who would like to have a relaxed conversation and have their speech and grammar corrected. These corrections can come in the moment or at the end of the lesson. For the latter option, I will take note of repeated errors throughout our conversation and then give you constructive feedback at the end. We can also find synonyms and other words for you to use to expand your vocabulary. Basically this class is whatever YOU want it to be. Whatever you'd like to talk about is the direction we will go. If you have no preference, I can suggest some topics too (music, movies, travel, nature, and much more). I love to chat about anything really. :)

pro_course_detail.title: Images
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is all about images, images, images. A visual approach to learning languages helps us bypass translating from our native language into the one we are learning. We learn a word and it's connected directly to the image thus eliminating the "middle man" so to say. 

In this lesson we will look at images and you will describe the situation in the picture as best as possible. Not settling for a rough approximation, we will find the best words and vocabulary to accurately describe what is going on. After that, we will get more specific and learn the words for specific objects in the picture. As you may well know, there are truly a lot of words in every language. This becomes very clear when you try to comprehensively describe an image, which often times has many elements to it. Is it blurry or in-focus? What are the people doing in the background? Where does it take place? What is the mood of the photo? How would you describe the expressions on the peoples faces?

These lessons are extremely fun. Especially in follow up lessons where we take the first few minutes to review the previous images and vocabulary. The specific vocabulary you had learned can be on the tip of your tongue! It's fun to see which words you can remember.

pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons will be conversation based and YOU will be doing most of the speaking. Either you will pick topics or I will pick topics that are relevant to your English journey- you can decide.

I will correct some of your mistakes during the lesson. I don't correct every single mistake but I will either correct you on the spot or will note all important mistakes. Sometimes it's necessary to wait until you have completed a sentence or thought before any correction should be done- it's important to also practice flow when speaking a foreign language. 

You will receive feedback from me via email after (or at the very end of) each lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: General English lessons / Grammar lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
General English lessons:

Our lessons will incorporate speaking, listening, writing, and grammar. Lessons will be tailored to meet your needs! I will send notes after each lesson, share relevant materials, and assign homework.

While we are in our lessons, we will probably divide the time up into two categories - speaking and grammar. Half the time we will focus on grammar, and half the time on speaking. Homework assigned will usually require you to do some writing, listening, reading, and definitely reviewing. 

After the first few lessons, I'll make a plan for us to follow- it's usually about a 40-lesson syllabus. We don't have to follow it, but it will be a helpful guide for us.

Grammar lessons:

In these lessons, we'll dive deep into all the questions that you might have about grammar. If you don't have specific questions, I will guide you with resources and I will explain with clarity how and why we formulate our sentences the way that we do. I will provide you with trustworthy, additional resources so you can learn from multiple perspectives. Our lessons will be completely customized to meet your needs.

Sometimes I teach grammar in the lessons and then assign homework- and sometimes I first assign homework and then the student "presents" what they've learned. Both systems work really well- the first system working well with A1-B2 students, and the second working well with B2-C1 students.

Perhaps you have a presentation you need to practice for, or a speaking exam tomorrow, or you're getting ready to travel abroad and need to warm up a bit. You will bring the topics and you will steer the conversation! 

*Lessons for adults only. Please note that if you'd like homework, lesson plans, or written feedback please take my speaking lessons instead.

pro_course_detail.title: English for young learners
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons will be mostly conversation based with lots of activities and games, especially with very young learners. This is an important age for language learning because kids learn QUICKLY and EASILY, and they learn the best without formal teaching. Students are pushed to speak, but on their own time- I build trust and focus on their confidence before any formal teaching. With most of my younger learners, I encourage NO formal teaching; it is better that they see me as a "friend" rather than a teacher (kids have enough school already!). At the end of the day, the lesson style is up to the parent- if the parent prefers me to formally teach, I will do that. 
When I am not "formally teaching" I am noting the student's frequent mistakes and new words, and I use the drilling method. After lots of repetition they will naturally correct their mistakes. 
*I only teach 30 minute lessons with very young learners- if there is a specific circumstance we can discuss 45-minute lessons.
